run: results/gpu_run1/e5_phase0.json and results/gpu_run1/e5_main.json (NVIDIA L4; Phase-0 gate finished 2026-10-26T18:53:11Z, confirmatory grid finished 19:00:24Z)
outcome: Infill-quality failure. Under the registered paper-level rule ('if the gates fail, it is an infill-quality failure, not an induction finding, and must not be reported as one'), run v1 supports no claim about in-context motif development, positive or negative.

quality_gate.rule: gap_voiced >= 0.6 and gap_polyphony <= 1.3 and |gap_rms_db_vs_context| <= 6 (the Phase-0 rule in run_analogy.gate_choice), applied here to every confirmatory row; registered threshold 75%

registered_indices_as_computed.note: Reported for completeness only; given the failed gate these values are not interpretable as evidence.

kill_criteria.K0: passed (655/658 even with ties counted as errors; 1-wrong-note AUC 0.929)
kill_criteria.K1: not triggered as implemented; not evaluable as registered (see deviations)
kill_criteria.K2: no interim was run; evaluated post hoc on the first 6 melodies it would not have triggered (CI_lit 0.189)

diagnosed_causes: All 144 repaint runs passed ACE-Step's text-to-music instruction to the DiT instead of its repaint instruction.

Within a seed the initial noise is identical across items and conditions, so the confirmatory grid contained only two independent noise draws, and the caption was selected on the same draw that seed 1001 reused.
Under identical noise, the text conditioning alone switched a pilot gap between audible and near-silent, so conditioning and noise interact; which factor dominates is untested.
Source clips were 20.4-21.2 s long (about 2.4 s of render tail after the last note) rather than the intended 18 s.
deviations_and_errata: Erratum to addendum 1: it states that the rename happened before any confirmatory run. The confirmatory grid had already finished (19:00:24Z) when addendum 1 was written (19:42:09Z). The run used the pre-rename code, whose hashes are the ones in e5_prereg.json; no data are affected.
K1 names flute, synth-voice and clarinet captions; Phase 0 actually compared three flute captions. This deviation was not disclosed before the run.

The scorer does not compute several registered quantities (CIs of the H2/H3 differences, RI under X-ctl, the NULL coincidence rate for T+6A, exact binomial tests, note-F1, onset-F1); ties in classification go to the first-listed hypothesis.
next: A corrected run (repaint instruction, independent noise per item, fresh melodies, quality gate checked before any hypothesis is scored) will be registered as a further addendum before it starts.
